result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but the horizontally scrolling 'Fastest near you' carousel has a card (Trattoria Piccol...) cut off at the right edge with its title truncated, and the bottom pizza card is partially clipped by the viewport, which may look unintentional without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with its name truncated mid-word, and there is no visible scroll indicator or peek padding to signal that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a subtle fade/scroll hint so users understand the row scrolls horizontally, and ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis gracefully.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is clipped at the bottom of the viewport above the tab bar, making it look like a rendering glitch rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for a scroll feed, but consider adding bottom content padding so the last visible card isn't awkwardly half-cut behind the navigation bar.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot indicator that may be hard to perceive for users with low vision or color-vision deficiencies.
issues.suggestion: Increase the badge size or add a numeric count / alternative visual cue for unread notifications.
